description:
This prospectus is being issued to solicit applications for a concession campground special use permit. One permit to provide high-quality public service in the operation and maintenance of Government-owned recreation facilities located on the High Cascades Ranger District of the Rogue River-Siskiyou National Forest.

The three-year average gross revenue for this opportunity is $252,791.94 (2023-2025).

See attached document for additional information.
